title: GreenBench: Benchmarking Energy Efficiency and Carbon Footprint of Open-Source LLM Inference on Apple Silicon
abstract: arXiv:2608.28667v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid proliferation of Large Language Models (LLMs) has raised concerns about their environmental impact during inference. While Green AI research has focused on datacenter GPUs and embedded platforms, the energy profile of LLM inference on Apple Silicon, with its unified memory architecture, remains unstudied. This paper presents GreenBench, a benchmarking framework that evaluates the energy efficiency, throughput, and carbon footprint of five open-source LLMs (3-9B parameters) across three NLP tasks on an Apple M4 Pro with 48 GB unified memory. Using macOS powermetrics for direct power measurement and Ollama's nanosecond-precision timing, we find that the M4 Pro draws only 0.47 W of CPU+GPU package power during sustained inference, with total system power of 8-12 W, achieving 30-40x better energy efficiency per token than datacenter GPUs in single-user deployment. Smaller models (3-3.8B) deliver 2.6-4.2x higher throughput and up

translated_title: GreenBench：在Apple Silicon上对开源大语言模型推理的能效与碳足迹进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速普及引发了人们对其推理过程中环境影响的担忧。虽然绿色AI研究主要聚焦于数据中心GPU和嵌入式平台，但具有统一内存架构的Apple Silicon上LLM推理的能耗特征仍未被研究。本文提出了GreenBench，这是一个基准测试框架，用于评估五个开源LLM（3-9B参数）在配备48 GB统一内存的Apple M4 Pro上跨三个NLP任务的能效、吞吐量和碳足迹。通过使用macOS powermetrics进行直接功率测量以及Ollama的纳秒级精度计时，我们发现M4 Pro在持续推理期间仅消耗0.47 W的CPU+GPU封装功率，系统总功率为8-12 W，在单用户部署场景下实现了比数据中心GPU每token高30-40倍的能效。较小的模型（3-3.8B）可提供2.6-4.2倍更高的吞吐量，且……
tldr: 本文提出GreenBench基准测试框架，首次系统评估了开源LLM在Apple Silicon（M4 Pro）上推理的能效、吞吐量与碳足迹，发现其单用户部署下每token能效比数据中心GPU高30-40倍，且更小的模型（3-3.8B）具有更高的吞吐量。
